thread:
tara-docs: Heads-up: opened PR #812 to update the JS migration guide and add an SDK snippet for async streaming. Preview is failing and security flagged a secret-like string in one example. PTAL @alex-security @nina-legal @matt-devex

ci-bot: docs-preview job error: markdownlint failure and build error: example.js contains trailing whitespace and possible secret token pattern. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/ci/812/logs

alex-security: Can you paste the snippet? If it's a real key we need a redaction entry and an internal ticket. If it's a sample, replace with process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY or REDWOOD_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER and mention it in the PR.

tara-docs: Snippet is below. I copied from an internal test file and missed sanitizing it:
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: "live_sk_98765abc" })
const stream = await client.stream("Explain the migration steps")
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
```
I'll switch to an env var and remove the literal. Also will run markdownlint locally.

nina-legal: Legal needs a one-line statement in the PR describing the accidental inclusion and confirming no customer data was exposed. We prefer that to be preserved in the changelog entry.

matt-devex: I can pick up the lint fixes and adjust the snippet. Once you push, I'll re-run the preview. Recommend we also add a short note in the docs about never pasting live keys into examples.

luis-eng: From platform side: this is doc-only, but if security wants an audit record tag me and I'll make sure the redaction ticket is linked to the infra audit. We normally wait for legal + security before merge.

tara-docs: Pushed commit: replaced literal with process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, added code comment to show how to set env var, cleaned lint. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 - included short redaction note.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed initially but redeploy queued by matt-devex. Redeploy in progress.

ci-bot: docs-preview succeeded ✅ — https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/812

alex-security: Confirmed redaction and no live key detected in repo history (ran a quick grep). Filed redaction ticket REDACT-2026-042 and added entry to internals/redactions/REDACT-2026-042.md

nina-legal: Legal sign-off given. Please include the following line in changelog: "Sanitized sample SDK key accidentally included in migration guide; replaced with placeholder and documented redaction (REDACT-2026-042)."

matt-devex: I'll merge at 18:30 UTC after tagging the changelog and adding the redaction note to release notes. Merging will be from the docs bot account to keep audit trail consistent.

tara-docs: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. Will follow up with a short contributor doc to avoid this in future.
